provider: TACC Corral (US) — 5 TB free per PI, $60/TB/year beyond

free_tier.stated: 'The first 5TB of storage for each PI, on one project, is available to researchers at all UT System institutions at no cost. For storage needs larger than 5TB, and for multiple project allocations, access to Corral is available at a cost of $60/TB/year.' 40 PB online + tape replica.

egress.terms: Not metered in the doc, but there is no public HTTP download path — Corral is a mounted/POSIX store, so serving is not its purpose.

tooling: POSIX with rsync/scp; TACC allocation portal.
chaining: 5 TB free × UT System PIs, then linear $60/TB/yr. The file-count rule is the real limiter: 'There is also a limit of 200,000 files per allocated terabyte' — at 5 TB that is 1 million files.
limits_note: per-object-cap: n/a. 200,000 files per allocated TB is a hard per-file-count cap that punishes the many-small-objects pattern. Retention: persistent, backed to tape. Gate: US-based institution for PI status ('Users from non-US institutions are not eligible for PI status'), and the free 5 TB is UT-System-specific.
